inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Multi Factor Authentication Disabled For User Account

properties.description: This rule detects changes to the "StrongAuthenticationRequirement" value, where the state is set to "0" or "Disabled"
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Multi Factor Authentication Disabled For User Account
properties.query:
// Detects when MFA (Strong Authentication) is disabled for a user
AuditLogs
| where LoggedByService =~ "Core Directory"
| where Category =~ "UserManagement"
| where OperationName =~ "Update user"
| mv-expand ModifiedProperties = TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties
| where tostring(ModifiedProperties.displayName) =~ "StrongAuthenticationRequirement"
| where tostring(ModifiedProperties.newValue) contains '"State":0'
| extend
    TimeGenerated,
    UserPrincipalName = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName),
    ModifiedBy = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
    ModifiedByApp = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName),
    CorrelationId,
    Result,
    TenantId = AADTenantId
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    UserPrincipalName,
    ModifiedBy,
    ModifiedByApp,
    OperationName,
    Result,
    CorrelationId,
    AADTenantId
| extend
    AccountCustomEntity = UserPrincipalName,
    InitiatorCustomEntity = ModifiedBy
